findings.evidence: Lines 219–223 state `P.toTableau ... i c = if (i, c) ∈ μ then P.tableauEntry i c else 0`, while the analogous `tableauEntry_def` at line 145 is tagged `@[simp]`.
findings.fix: Mark `toTableau_apply` with `@[simp]`; this also makes `toTableau_apply_of_mem` follow automatically in simplification.
findings.issue: `toTableau_apply` is the public unfolding rule for the opaque `toTableau` definition but lacks `@[simp]`, so simplification cannot reduce tableau evaluation even when cell membership is known.

findings.evidence: Lines 318–321 identify `(toGTPattern T n) i j` with `patternEntry T n i j`; `patternEntry_def` at line 270 is already a simp lemma, but cannot fire until this missing outer reduction occurs.
findings.issue: `toGTPattern_apply` is the characteristic evaluation rule for the opaque `toGTPattern` definition but lacks `@[simp]`, forcing every consumer to rewrite it manually.

summary: The conversion definitions have characteristic application lemmas, but two normal-form lemmas are missing automation annotations.
